grounding.observation: C7 failed while sampling rectangular panel support, before simulation. C6 displacement failure and all earlier image rejections remain. Exact338 final correction authority is unchanged.
grounding.comparison: New338 approval extends attempts, not appearance acceptance.

expert_coverage.observation: Support/pinning, topology, garment cache transfer, crown seam and revealing cameras have explicit methods and falsification checks.
expert_coverage.comparison: Face and headwear quality remain required even if drape improves.

film_alignment.observation: Accepted Pashtun remains the material and integrated-form floor.
film_alignment.comparison: Night lighting and supporting framing are differences, not permission for a mannequin.

preferences.observation: Proceed internally through known defects within the four approved corrections.
preferences.comparison: No algorithm choice or incremental known-failure review is sent to the Director.

reference_roles.observation: Faithful motion reference and accepted-quality appearance comparator remain distinct and unchanged.
reference_roles.comparison: Static drape does not qualify full-speed animation or cultural identity.

method.observation: Reviewed measured-domain sampling: require support at each of35 row heights on both sides, choose90percent of minimum contiguous half-width, require width above6cm. Then settle regular panels with pinned boundaries. Four unit regressions pass but they do not validate native support or simulation.
method.comparison: This repairs the specific unsupported panel boundary assumption without disabling support or displacement guards. It cannot by itself fix face, crown or saddle defects; images remain decisive.

interfaces.observation: Actual code preserves x/z and shoulder/cuff/waist boundaries, interpolates panel depth to central torso and applies it to every cached pose. Existing layer refit and revealing stance/crest controls remain.
interfaces.comparison: Body-pose transfer can fail despite bounded numerical displacement. This remains a rejection condition.

efficient_quality.observation: Two actors and focused five-image proof precede replication or integrated rerender.
efficient_quality.comparison: No surface decoration is counted as proof of credible cloth, face or tack.

authority.observation: Same task correction8/max8, the last appearance correction approved338. No new provider, spending, installation or master change; no automatic retry follows failure.
authority.comparison: No additional spend, provider, upload, install or master change.

strongest_counterexample: The measured panel may be too narrow or still fail cloth convergence. A converged small patch may not visibly improve the whole garment and cannot clear the independent face/crown/saddle failures. Exhaustion must remain failure, not an incremental artistic handoff.
